notes.title: 29/06/2024-Update
notes.notes:
Note: Some users might experience sudden ending of a level earlier. We are learning and working on this potential bug. We will fix it as soon as possible. Sorry for the experience if you have it.

1- We improved the Mine Trade section and its Advisor panel. In the Mine Trade section, the user will be able to sell ores, crystals, gemstones etc. The sale will take place either in instalments or lump sum according to the cash needs of the user. The Advisor will recommend accordingly. The number of saleable items is few for the time being.
2- We added a Recruitment section and its Advisor panel, where the player will be able to recruit/hire units for leading the defense better. 
3-We added an Exploration section and its Advisor panel. The Exploration section will allow users to find new ores, crystals, and other tradable materials to further improve their empire. Finding of new tradables will take place later in the game. It is not crucial for the proper strategy building for now as the Exploration costs are a bit high at this stage and current levels. The Advisor recommends not to pay for it.
